haiku:
Fork the repo, friend
Stars do not pay the server bill
Ship it anyway

Servers hum all night
Commits pile up like fresh snow
Dawn deploy, no bugs

The scheduler ticks
Eighty-eight tiny cron jobs
None of them matter

Green squares on my graph
A calendar made of lies
Still counts as progress

Pi digit found here
One more decimal closer
Never quite arrives
